title: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
task: Stabilizing residual stream mixing in multi-stream neural networks
key_results: cmHC reduces hyper-connection latency by 44.8% on Ascend NPUs; proves stream mixing bounds theoretically
comments: Addresses a subtle but important architectural problem—the geometric trade-off between stream independence and coherence—with both theoretical guarantees and practical gains.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Under-mixed matrices near Birkhoff polytope vertices degenerate into independent streams
hypotheses.result: Validated by bounding cumulative residual mixing and stream differences

hypotheses.hypothesis: Over-mixed matrices concentrated at barycenter reduce stream distinguishability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; moderate contraction prevents over-mixing at shallow layers

title: Non-penetrating World Models
task: Preventing object penetration in interactive video world models
key_results: NoPeWorld reduces physical violation rate from 74% to 16% across six models; zero-shot generalization to open-domain imagery, third-person viewpoints
comments: Cleverly leverages existing diffusion-transformer representations rather than retraining, achieving strong generalization with a lightweight adapter.

hypotheses.hypothesis: DiT hidden states encode sufficient information to predict penetration violations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; small prediction head on frozen DiT achieves strong performance

title: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report
task: Mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with extended reasoning
key_results: 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified, 51.7 on Terminal-Bench 2.1; 680 tokens/s on single GB300 GPU; joint decision-model improves group accuracy from 65.4% to 77.0%
comments: Strong agentic performance suggests that diffusion-based token generation with gating and memory may scale competitive with autoregressive approaches for reasoning tasks.

model_io.model: Clover-35B (35B total, 3B active) mixture-of-experts diffusion LM

title: Reading the Unreadable: Text-Aware Image Super-Resolution Needs Reasoning
task: Text-aware image super-resolution via reasoning and language models
key_results: RTC plugin improves text-conditioned SR models on reasoning-required text; real-world SR with RTC outperforms TAISR with RTC
comments: Important insight that severe text degradation requires semantic reasoning beyond local visual information; using MLLMs as external reasoning modules is elegant and training-free.

model_io.model: SR model + MLLM (reasoning external) + RTC captioning

hypotheses.hypothesis: Severe text degradation cannot be recovered from local visual evidence alone
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by performance gap on reasoning-required text; MLLM reasoning transfers effectively

title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
task: Scalable memory architecture for LLMs with long contexts
key_results: 1313× memory reduction, 6.9× prefill speedup at 1M context; 3.5× throughput improvement; +5.77% overall memory performance on Qwen3.5-4B
comments: Elegant dual design combining compact memory encoding with sparse retrieval achieves strong linear-time scaling while maintaining competitive downstream performance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Caching final-layer hidden states and decoding on-demand reduces KV cache overhead
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves linear-time complexity with minimal performance loss

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sparse indices computed once per layer generalize across attention heads
hypotheses.result: Supported by experimental results; enables efficient prefill

title: Duopra: From Full-Duplex Conversation to Full-Duplex Agency
task: Full-duplex interaction model for conversational agents with tool use
key_results: Pass@1 improves from 4.7% to 44.7%; 47.7% calling tools directly; improves three FDB v1.0 takeover rates
comments: Addresses the dual challenge of natural conversation and timely, correct tool execution by treating task execution as a learned behavior alongside conversational control.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Treating backend as a tool with unified action interface improves task execution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; task agency coexists with conversational agency

title: Lost in the Hallway: Benchmarking Persistent Spatial Memory Across Revisits
task: Benchmarking persistent spatial memory across revisits in embodied agents

hypotheses.hypothesis: Iterative evidence seeking alone does not ensure consistent spatial memory
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; agentic frameworks show no overall improvement over direct inference

title: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
task: Metric 3D spatial reasoning from calibrated stereo for vision-language models
key_results: 95.17% depth accuracy (δ₁) on Stereo3D-Bench; 66.98 average object-level score; 3.54 point gains on spatial benchmarks; 4.3pp improvement in RoboCasa manipulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Disparity supervision generalizes better than direct depth supervision across unseen environments

title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
task: Action-level analysis of frontier multimodal agents for direct robot control
key_results: Frontier agents show strong zero-shot manipulation and closed-loop recovery; Muse-Glimmer-30B failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24% with fine-tuning

model_io.model: Frontier multimodal agents (e.g., GPT-6 Astra) + AgentRoboCritic evaluator

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frontier agents can recover from local execution failures via closed-loop sensing

title: AeroRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
task: Recursive self-improvement for aerial vision-language navigation
key_results: Success rate improves from 46.4% to 67.5% in three rounds; collisions reduced by half; surpasses prior SOTA by 10.6pp
comments: Elegant self-improvement loop where the policy judges its own repairs by flying on from them; avoids need for human labeling by using rollout continuation as supervision signal.

model_io.model: AeroRSI (recursive self-improvement framework with VLA policy)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Policy failures can be corrected by self-generated repairs verified through rollout continuation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; three rounds substantially improve success rate without human annotations

title: PURE: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Multi-Granularity Multimodal Identity Matching
task: Multi-granularity multimodal identity matching with capability diagnostics
key_results: MLLM scores range 47.1–86.0%; Understanding highest mean (weakest on Judgment); modality ablations show models benefit from multimodal evidence but struggle with conflicts
comments: PURE elegantly separates aggregate matching accuracy into four capability dimensions, exposing that models recognize matching pairs better at base level but non-matching pairs at variant level.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Variant-level matching is fundamentally more difficult than base-level matching
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; models' performance pattern reverses between base and variant levels

title: Moving Generality from Model to Modeler: LLM Agents for PHM on a Deployment-Style Benchmark
task: LLM agents for prognostics and health management on deployment-style benchmark
key_results: Frontier agents outperform AutoML by >2×; published methods replicate poorly; agent advantage stems from learned design on each machine's data, transferable as plain-text plan
comments: NextUnit-Bench reveals that generality is moving from model to modeler; frontier agents' edge comes from adaptive design rather than fixed architectures, but deployed open-weight models struggle to execute these designs.

model_io.model: Frontier coding agents (LLM-based with two-hour deployment budget)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent advantage is transferable as a design plan rather than model weights
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; strongest agent's design plan carries most gap, weak agents reproduce plans identically

hypotheses.hypothesis: Open-weight models cannot reliably execute frontier agents' complex designs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; deployed models deliver designs only half as often

title: Prune to Expand: Training Prompt Enhancers with Less to Imitate
task: Refining supervision for prompt enhancement in image generation
key_results: P2E achieves comparable or better results than dense-caption SFT with pruned supervision; improves alignment with human preferences across diverse image categories
comments: Counterintuitive finding that caption pairs with marginal generation gains supervise PE models as well as high-gain pairs suggests that redundant visual details hurt generalization; selective pruning is elegant.

model_io.model: Prompt Enhancement (PE) model + text-only pruning method (P2E)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dense captions impose redundant supervision weakly related to user intent
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; caption pairs with marginal gains supervise equally well as high-gain pairs

title: Taking Apart and Putting Together: Tracking Objects Through Physical Transformations
task: Object tracking through physical assemblies and disassemblies
key_results: TIPO achieves state-of-the-art tracking and state-graph accuracy on VISTA; 6–15× faster than prior methods; correctly tracks 124 assembly and 132 disassembly events across 50 sequences
comments: TIPO's training-free generate-evaluate-judge pipeline cleverly extends SAM 2/3 beyond appearance changes to semantic identity shifts; generates split/merge proposals and uses MLLM for verification.

model_io.model: TIPO (proposal generation + mask overlap scoring + MLLM verification)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Foundation models cannot update semantic identities as objects physically evolve
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; TIPO adds continuous transformation inference to maintain semantic state

title: Exploited Before It Was Fixed? Vulnerability Timelines from Open, Machine-Readable Evidence
task: Mapping vulnerability exploitation timelines from machine-readable evidence
key_results: 98% of 3,758 vulnerabilities have disclosure dates; only 15.7% have patch evidence; 59 vulnerabilities show exploitation before patching (median 7.6 days); 40% measurement error in one collector
comments: Vulnerability-Lookup's rigorous evidence model exposes that exploitation-to-patch timelines are computable but fragile, dependent on evidence provenance and precision; systematic collector errors dominate.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exploitation-to-patch intervals are measurable from published evidence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed but heavily dependent on evidence availability and precision

title: Intent Contracts: Taking Tools Away from Agents
task: Authorization interface for tool-using LLM agents via intent contracts
key_results: Contracts complete ambiguous tasks in 27/30 runs vs 16/30 for intent-visible reviewer; every state change named in contract goal under contracts vs rarely in commands under review
comments: Intent contracts move accountability upstream by logging planner goals before execution; however, they cannot prevent errors in object reference resolution that only the environment can verify.

model_io.model: LLM planner + trusted model executor + contract validator

hypotheses.hypothesis: Contracts are indistinguishable from permission review when both see the same information
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; prevents unauthorized actions but not incorrect object references

title: Explicit Style Extraction for Personalized Long-Form Text Generation
task: Explicit style extraction for personalized long-form text generation
key_results: SP-Refine outperforms retrieval-augmented baseline in 25/27 ROUGE/METEOR comparisons; 10.2% average improvement, up to 35.8%; profile alone is worse in all 27 comparisons
comments: StylePrism taxonomy captures concrete, checkable habits; two-pass revision against explicit profile is more effective than relying on model to infer style from samples in context.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit style extraction improves personalization better than implicit sample-based inference

title: GameWM: Toward Next-Generation Video Games with Interaction-Centric World Models
task: Interaction-centric world models for next-generation video games
key_results: GameWM enables diverse visual and physical realizations of one game mechanic while preserving engine-computed outcomes; model family 5B–33B with real-time causal variant
comments: Novel division of labor between engine (rules, state, layout) and VM (look, interaction detail) lets one mechanic spawn many visual experiences; fresh per-player generation while maintaining mechanical consistency.

title: Motion-Aware Reward Modeling for Instruction-Guided Video Editing
task: Motion-aware reward modeling for instruction-guided video editing
key_results: Motion-aware reward reduces selection of motion-suppressed candidates to 0% (from 97%); Spearman correlation 0.57 with human quality; preserves motion during reward-guided fine-tuning
comments: Motion collapse is a subtle but important failure mode in composite rewards; explicit inter-frame dynamics input combined with preference training against suppression variants is effective.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Composite rewards favor temporal consistency at expense of motion

title: Chitosan exerts dual insecticidal effects against Culex pipiens through multi-target catalytic enzyme binding and electrostatic membrane disruption
task: Elucidate chitosan's dual insecticidal mechanism via enzyme binding and membrane disruption
key_results: Chitosan LC₅₀ 4.85 mg/mL against Culex larvae; MM-PBSA binding free energies: AChE −44.0 kcal/mol, chitin synthase −37.2 kcal/mol; membrane thinning −3.9%, water penetration increased fourfold; glucosamine–phosphate interaction 62.4% electrostatic
comments: Comprehensive computational validation across docking, MD, and MM-PBSA is thorough, but direct experimental confirmation of enzyme inhibition and membrane permeabilization in treated larvae remains essential.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dual mechanism confers low resistance risk
hypotheses.result: Multiple structurally independent binding sites engaged simultaneously

title: The GSDME-CCL2 feedback loop regulates tumor cell pyroptosis and tumor-associated macrophage dynamics
task: Elucidate GSDME-CCL2 feedback loop in pyroptosis and macrophage dynamics
